Because these pitfalls are common, if you’ve worked on any AI product, you’ve probably seen them before.

1. Use generative AI when you don't need generative AI

Every time there’s a new technology, I can hear the collective sigh of senior engineers everywhere: “Not everything is a nail.” Generative AI isn’t an exception — its seemingly limitless capabilities only exacerbate the tendency to use generative AI for everything.

They fed a household’s list of energy-intensive activities and hourly electricity prices into an LLM, then asked it to create a schedule to minimize energy costs. events.excerpt: # Release v5.23.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling2 Inkling 2 Small is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and it is intended for use in English and other languages and across multiple coding languages. Its language backbone has 48 mixture-of-experts decoder layers, each routing tokens to 8 of 384 experts, for 594B total and 17B active parameters. It keeps the Inkling decoder (learned relative attention, short causal convolutions, mixture-of-experts layers) and adds block attention residuals, gated attention with a learned sink, and dynamic key/value convolutions. Images are encoded by a Perception Encoder-based vision transformer and projected into the language model embeddings, one embedding per 40x40 pixel patch. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/inkling2) | [Blog Post](https://thinkingmachines.ai/news/inkling-2-small/) * Add inkling2 (#50682) by @guarin in [#50682](https://github.com/huggingface/transforme

Datasette Lite is my port of the Datasette Python application to run directly in the browser using WebAssembly and Pyodide. I've released a complete rewrite of Datasette Lite using service workers, and it's now almost indistinguishable from the real server-side application.

You can now do all of the following, using a carefully crafted URL to lite.datasette.io:

  • Load client-side Datasette to browse any SQLite database, JSON file, CSV file or SQL script
  • Select a released version of Datasette to load from PyPI
  • Load a specific commit, tag, or branch name from the Datasette GitHub repository
  • Pick from over 100 versions of SQLite to use with Datasette
  • Install additional Datasette plugins from PyPI or URLs to wheel files, including JavaScript visualization tools

The ability to load specific Datasette references, plugins, and SQLite versions makes this a fantastic tool for linking to demos of work-in-progress features or bug reproductions, without needing to spin up a full web server to serv

### Features

* **api:** add beta support for the billing_policy request parameter
* **api:** add contract_spend_limit_reached error code to messages
* **api:** add error codes for linked billing refusals
* **api:** add the user_profile_billing_not_authorized error code
* **api:** add webhook events for external key failure and recovery


### Bug Fixes

* **client:** stop reporting failed aiohttp connections as timeouts
* **types:** keep deprecated model aliases and the types nested under them working


### Chores

* **api:** rename error data models, deprecating the old names
* **docs:** clarify which AWS KMS keys a workspace can use on Claude Platform on AWS
* **docs:** clarify which credential work get, update and list accept
* **docs:** clarify which uploads a plugin pin holds back
* **docs:** note that a plugin scan's reason also covers errored scans

  `content_scan.reason` on an errored scan now says why there is no verdict. It is not a security finding, so code that treats any `reason` as a concern should also check `status`.

* **internal:** don't report moved classes as breaking changes


### Documentation

* name each SDK's own types in rename deprecations

events.excerpt:
# v0.34.0

**1,061 commits from 412 contributors (120 new).** Thank you!

## TL;DR

- **10 new models** (Mistral Large 4, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe, and more!)
- **Extensible KV cache is on by default:** vLLM sizes the KV cache from memory actually free after warmup, so most models get a bigger cache and more throughput.
- **Model Runner V1 is gone.** Model Runner V2 is now the only GPU runner.
- **Big speedups** on Blackwell and MI355X: up to 1.95× decode (Step5 on GB200), 1.6× throughput (GLM-5.3-Flash), 1.24–1.40× faster long-prompt TTFT (GLM-5.3).
- **Upgrade check:** default block size is now 64, ROCm 7.2 images are gone, and `huggingface_hub >= 2.0.0` is required. See [Before you upgrade](#before-you-upgrade).

## Before you upgrade

> [!IMPORTANT]
> These changes can break existing setups.

| Change | What to do | PR |
|---|---|---|
| Model Runner V1 removed | Remove `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0`; it now fails at startup. Port V1 logits processors to `vllm.v1.worker.gpu.sample.logits_processor`. | #63373 |
| Default `--block-size` is 64 (was 16) | Pass `--block-size 16` to keep the old behavior. ROCm paged attention still uses 16. | #6323
